features: NO SCHEMA CHANGES, BUT IN TWO CASES IT WRITES ON DATA THAT ALREADY EXISTS — The credit realignment adds journal entries to correct those that versions up to 1.10 wrote on the wrong account or did not write: from the payments page only after you confirm, from the console when you run the command. Recalculating a plan after a reversal puts the instalment reference back on journal lines that had lost it: amounts, accounts, dates and people do not change. No migration. This beta fixes the accounting of credits carried over from a previous year: since 1.9 issuing left out of the journal the expense of the shares that the carried-over credit brings to zero or below, and offsetting and refunds took the carried-over credit from «Receivables from owners», where nobody had written it.

CHANGED: AN INSTALMENT MADE ONLY OF CREDITS GOES TO THE JOURNAL — Since beta.42 it stayed in draft; in 1.9 and 1.10 it was marked «issued» with no lines. Now issuing writes both parts of every credit share: the instalment's expense as a debit and the carried-over credit that pays it as a credit, on «Receivables from owners», with «Instalment Management» and the «Past Management Fund» on the other side. The instalment becomes «issued» and stops the plan from being recalculated: to recalculate it, cancel the issue, after reversing the payments, offsets or refunds that touch it. The same for a credit share inside an instalment that also has debts. Only an instalment with nothing to post stays in draft, and the outcome says so.

CHANGED: THE CARRIED-OVER CREDIT COMES OUT OF THE «PAST MANAGEMENT FUND» — Offsetting («Use credit») and refunds take the carried-over credit of a share not yet in the journal from the «Past Management Fund», and the rest (the year's income, the credit of a share already in the journal, an overpayment) from «Receivables from owners»; a share with both parts is split across the two accounts, carried-over part first. The refund window says which account it comes from. If the «Past Management Fund» account (2301) is missing, offsetting and refunding a carried-over credit are refused with the reason: before, they silently fell back on «Receivables from owners». New offsets have the description «Compensazione con il credito».

CHANGED: THE YEAR'S INCOME IS NOT A CARRIED-OVER CREDIT — The share of a unit with more income than expenses (antenna rent on a garage, for example) is posted as a credit on «Receivables from owners», and in the account statement the line is called «Quota delle entrate dell'anno» (share of the year's income).

CHANGED: SHARES OF PLANS GENERATED BEFORE 1.8.0 ARE NOT GUESSED — Without the calculation detail, with a credit involved, there is no way to know how much is expense and how much carried-over credit. That share alone stays out of the journal, even when it is zero, and the issuing outcome names it with the person and the instalment; the other shares of the instalment are posted. To post it, recalculate the plan: issuing the instalment is not enough.

CHANGED: REVERSING A PAYMENT THAT USED A CREDIT — It writes the mirror of the payment and, if the credit had come out before its instalment was posted, a child entry that moves it back to «Receivables from owners». Cancelling an issue also deletes its child entries. Two reversals of the same payment at the same moment: the second finds the first and stops.

CHANGED: THE REVERSAL CONFIRMATION WARNS WHEN THE EXTRA PART HAS ALREADY BEEN USED — If the payment had paid a share more than due and that part has already been offset or refunded, the reversal does not undo that use: the confirmation says the instalment, the person, how much has already been used, where (reference and date) and how much will be due again. If the warning does not arrive within 15 seconds, the confirmation says so.

NEW: CREDITS TO REALIGN — The payments page shows a card if versions up to 1.10 left credits written wrongly: offsets that took a carried-over credit from «Receivables from owners», and credit shares left out of their instalment's issue. «Write the corrections» says how many entries it adds and writes them on the date and in the year of the entry they correct, with the description «Riallineamento crediti (1.11)»; existing entries are not changed, and the correction of an offset is reversed together with it. Instalments made only of credits marked «issued» with no lines are listed by the card with a link to the plan page, where you issue them yourself; whatever cannot be written stays listed, with the reason. From the console: php artisan kondomanager:riallinea-crediti, which does not ask for confirmation: with --dry-run it only shows, without it it writes straight away, and without --condominio it does so for every building. Instalments issued with 1.8 are not recognised as such: that version posted only the expense of the shares, and the carried-over balance of the shares it posted stays out of the journal.

CHANGED: RECALCULATING AFTER A REVERSAL KEEPS THE LINKS — Recalculating a plan, or removing an item, after a reversed payment erased the link between the payment, its correction and the share; now the links move to the new share, also when cancelling a transfer merges the prior-balance share back. Recalculating and removing an item are the only places where the program touches lines already in the journal, and they touch only the instalment reference.

CHANGED: THE ACCOUNT STATEMENT — The prior balance paid through the plan enters the statement of whoever pays it, once. «Total charges» and «Total paid» do not count the pairs of a reversal, which weigh zero on the balance (a reversed € 100,00 payment inflated both by € 100,00); the lines stay in the list. The «A copertura Rata n.1» line that matched nothing is gone; with two identical shares of the same person each line takes its own; lines of a plan of another year weigh their full amount. On screen and in the PDF. The cash forecast counts the net: the carried-over credit is not a receipt, and a reversed payment no longer counts as collected.

FIXES — The reversal confirmation multiplied the payment amount by 100. The entry page said «movement cancelled» also for a valid payment with its offset: now only for reversals, and it shows the others as «linked entries». An instalment marked «issued» with no lines, taken from a transfer of beta.41, is not issued again: the buyer would pay twice. The payments page shows the message after an operation. «1 rata», not «1 rate»; the agreements in the outcome, the card and the command.

THE GUIDES — The instalment plan guide says that an instalment made only of credits is posted too, the only cases that are not, and that an issued instalment stops recalculation. The payments guide has two new sections: which account the credit comes from, and what happens if the payment is then reversed.

NOT YET — The cash book shows as the amount of a credit instalment the debit total of its entry; the realignment and a new offset on the same share, at the same instant, do not have a shared lock yet; the «Credito disponibile» of the account statement is gross: it also adds the credit shares of draft instalments and does not subtract the debt of the other shares.

FOR DEVELOPERS — No migration. In RataQuote one credit rule: ruoloDelCredito(), componenti(), dareDiEmissione(), righeDiEmissione(), creditoUscitoDaPassate(), scritturaDiEmissione(), fermaSenzaDettaglio(). PianoRate::saldoAssorbito(). RigeneraRateTenendoILegami. AvvisoStornoIncasso and the admin.gestionale.movimenti-rate.storno.anteprima route. RiallineaCreditiService, the kondomanager:riallinea-crediti command, RiallineaCreditiController, the riallineamento_crediti prop. ContoPassateGestioniMancanteException. Net Rata::incassi. Front end storniScrittura.ts, confermaStorno.ts, statoRigaEstratto.ts. New tests: CreditiEmissioneEstrattoContoTest, CreditiStornoTest, LegamiDopoIlRicalcoloTest, RiallineaCreditiTest, CreditiRevisioneEstrattoTest, CreditiRevisioneCriterioTest, CreditiRevisioneEmissioneTest, CreditiGiroStrettoTest and four vitest files.
